regions.contentLimits: One full-screen experience with a video-first Nature cover, screen-filling gap-free two-column galleries, two Friendly Faces upload slots, a breathing cue, RUST gateway links, and a final-page multi-line one-liner input.
regions.overflow: The active screen scrolls within the stage. Gallery tiles stay in two columns without captions or gaps, except for empty upload guidance.

responsive.compact: The experience fills the viewport without a phone frame.
responsive.wide: The experience sits centered in a dark-graphite phone frame at the phone container width.

focus.onError: Local image and storage failures are announced without moving focus.

accessibility.headings: The phone exposes one level-one heading for the current screen. Navigation moves focus to that heading.
accessibility.labels: Every image upload, cover action, navigation action, gateway link, and final-page one-liner action has a programmatic label. Uploaded image file names supply temporary alternative text.
accessibility.statusAnnouncements: File and local-storage failures use an alert. The one-liner save result uses a polite status message.
